'''''Arcane''''' was Future Publishing's British role-playing magazine. Issue 5 (April 1996) printed [[Andy Butcher]]'s Star Wars CCG review [[Star Wars: Customizable Card Game (Arcane 5)|Star Wars: Customizable Card Game]] on page 70.<ref name="arcane5" />

The dated catalog is [[Magazines]].
